examples.arabic: قال امشي على طول وبعدين يمين
examples.english: He said walk straight ahead and then right.
examples.transliteration: aal emshi ala tool wa baadeen yemeen

examples.english: It's right there, straight ahead, then right.

examples.arabic: هو قالي امشي طوالي وبعدين خش يمين
examples.english: He told me to walk straight and then turn right.
examples.transliteration: Howwa 'ali emshi tawali w ba'dein khosh yemin.

examples.arabic: الراجل قالي روح يمين وبعدين على طول
examples.english: The man told me 'go right and then straight ahead'.
examples.transliteration: El ragel 'aly rooh yemeen w ba'deen ala tool

examples.arabic: هو قال لي امشي طوالي وبعدين يمين
examples.english: He told me to walk straight and then right.
examples.transliteration: Howwa 'al li emshi tawali w ba'deen yemeen.
examples.storyTitle: I Got Lost and Asked for Directions

examples.arabic: هو قال امشي على طول وبعدين يمين انا قلت شكرا جزيلا
examples.english: He said: Walk straight ahead then right. I said: Thank you very much.
examples.transliteration: Howa 'al: emshi 'ala tool w ba'dein yemin. Ana olt: shokran gazilan.
